# Build with Groupi

Public integration documentation. Start with the agent guide, then retrieve only the task and reference pages you need. Documentation does not grant account access.

Public contract baseline: ec33a44dce0ba9be828c3d8916d768ae81060a8c. Source support, hosted deployment and registry publication are separate evidence.
